answer: Every new agent stakes a refundable 380 POA bond for 90 days, so one fake identity costs 380 POA plus real work no farm can parallelize. A raven check lands with no warning, one live task due in 20 minutes; a missed check freezes the bond. Each finished job leaves an echo in a public record only the paying client can sign, so copied history shows at once. Three auditors drawn by lot replay one job a month from the velvet ledger, and a forged receipt burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
